dublin_core_group.title: Miami-Dade Streets
dublin_core_group.description:
A line feature class of Miami-Dade County streets with seamless address ranges.

A line feature class of Miami-Dade County streets with seamless address ranges. This feature class (FC) is one of a set of FC's derived from our main Streets FC, which were created to display street information.

iso_group.process_step:
#########
# GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
# and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
####

#########
# Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
####

# create directory structure and move into it
mkdir -p /data/mdc_streets/download -p /data/mdc_streets/etl
chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_streets
cd /data/mdc_streets

# set update flag based on last update and update frequency
do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1

# download if update flag is set:
if do_update == 1 then
ogr2ogr -nln mdc_streets download/mdc_streets.geojson 'https://services.arcgis.com/8Pc9XBTAsYuxx9Ny/arcgis/rest/services/GeoStreets_gdb/FeatureServer/0/query?outFields=*&where=1%3D1&outSR=4326&f=geojson 2>&1'

# load into postGIS with:
ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_streets.geojson -nlt multilinestring -nln mdc_streets
echo success: mdc_streets.geojson loaded with ogr2ogr


#########
# Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
####

# remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
UPDATE mdc_streets
  SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));

# add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
ALTER TABLE mdc_streets DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
  'mdc_streets',
  'geom_local', 2236, 'multilinestring', 2
);
UPDATE mdc_streets
  SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
CREATE INDEX mdc_streets_geom_local_idx
  ON mdc_streets
  USING GIST (geom_local);
NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';

Road type classification       0 -- Expressway Ramp -- Access ramps to expressways only
  1 -- Expressway -- Limited access roadways
  2 -- Highway -- Non-Limited access highways examples: US 1, KROME AVE
  3 -- Major Road -- Major roads that serve a large volume of traffic
  4 -- Feeder Road -- Roads that connect major roads and minor roads
  5 -- Minor Road -- Any other road recognized as a street  
  6 -- Alley -- Roads serving as secondary means of vehicular acces
  7 -- Non Paved -- Dirt roads, farm or maintenance
  8 -- Driveway, Accessway		
  9 -- New Subdivision -- New subdivision - planned roadway
Length of street arc, or -1 if traffic is not allowed going form the begining of the arc to the end as it was digitized
Length of the street arc, or -1 if traffic is not allowed going form the end of the arc to the beginning  as it was digitized
